meta.title: Date Filter re-scopes the dashboard data

args.goal: On the Home Page dashboard, note the default-range metric values, open the top-left date selector, choose a different date range covering a different set of events, and verify that the dashboard data refreshes and Total Events and the other metrics reflect the selected range, with at least one metric value changing; stop on the filtered dashboard

steps.note: Performs the date-range selection and verifies the resulting dashboard metric changes, which no specialized catalog step exposes.
Confirms the filtered dashboard remains rendered without errors or raw data artifacts.
